svg.aria-label: How it works: 1 observe, Tier 0 reads every message; 2 audit, a sentinel samples the mesh within a fixed budget; 3 trace, walk the flagged claim's lineage back to its source; 4 accumulate, suspicion builds on the source; 5 respond, isolate, flag downstream and alert within a cap; 6 score, the world keeps the answer key and HARPY never reads it.
